description: This file defines a MetricsLogObserver class for logging various performance and usage metrics related to the Pipecat framework, including token usage, processing times, and turn prediction metrics. It handles MetricsFrame instances and logs detailed information using the loguru logger.

classes.name: MetricsLogObserver
classes.description: An observer class that logs metrics data to the console, monitoring MetricsFrame instances and selectively logging different types of metrics such as token usage, processing times, and turn predictions.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the MetricsLogObserver with optional filtering of metrics types to log.

methods.name: on_push_frame
methods.description: Handles incoming frame push events, processes MetricsFrame instances, and logs their metrics data.

methods.name: _should_log_metrics
methods.description: Determines whether a given metrics data item should be logged based on the include_metrics filter.

methods.name: _log_metrics_data
methods.description: Logs individual metrics data items, formatting output based on the metrics type.

methods.name: _log_llm_usage
methods.description: Logs detailed token usage information for LLMUsageMetricsData.

methods.name: _log_smart_turn
methods.description: Logs detailed information for SmartTurnMetricsData, including prediction completeness and timing metrics.
